# object_attribute_change

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

One recorded change to a time-indexed object attribute.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `object_id` | `string` | yes | Identifier of the object whose attribute changed. |
| `attribute_name` | `string` | yes | The changed attribute name. |
| `old_value` | `string` | no | Optional previous value (absent if this is the first recorded value). |
| `new_value` | `string` | yes | The new value after the change. |
| `changed_at` | `datetime` | yes | ISO8601 timestamp the change took effect. |
